_doc: Pilot 7 matrix (ADR-0037). Read by agentdx/pilot7.py; `python3 -m agentdx pilot7 --dry-run` validates it without any LLM call.

prices._source: Anthropic first-party API list prices, USD per million tokens, as cached in the Claude API reference on that date. cache_write is the 5-minute write (1.25 x input) and cache_read 0.1 x input where the table gives no explicit figure (marked derived). The CLI aliases are assumed to resolve to the current generation; the harness records the resolved model id when Claude Code reports it and checks every trial's computed cost against Claude Code's own total_cost_usd. cache_write_1h (2 x input) is used for the 1-hour cache writes Claude Code reports in modelUsage; the 2026-11-11 haiku validation smoke reproduced Claude Code's own costUSD with it.

_validation: 2026-11-11 haiku arm-R smoke, USD 0.30 of the 1.50 validation budget, records in results/pilot7-validation/. Round 1 (14 candidates, 1 trial): 14 of 14 passed, 12 in 3 turns, no rustc error. Round 2 (t306-t309, 2 trials): 5 of 8 passed; t309 failed 2 of 2 and t306 1 of 2 on hidden edge cases (no rustc error in any trial), t307 took 13 turns once. Chosen: the four round-2 tasks, the two pilot-6 friction tasks (t103, t104) and the four largest round-1 tasks.
_expected_basis: Expected cost per trial = the validation smoke's token counts priced per model (dry-run decomposition: arm R on the chosen tasks is USD 0.011 haiku, 0.21 sonnet, 0.42 opus at equal tokens), raised for the Windjammer arms' extra turns. At 2 trials per cell opus alone would project about USD 27, so opus runs 1 trial per cell (30 trials) to keep the expected total under the hard cap; the owner may raise it.
